title: Captain Mark's Dolphin Cruise

services.name: Hilton Head Dolphin Tour
services.desc: Captain Mark’s Hilton Head dolphin tour is perfect for families, couples, groups, and solo travelers of all ages. Enjoy a relaxing cruise, narrated by Hilton Head’s most experienced captain. You’ll see the coastal landscape and wildlife that can only be found on a Hilton Head dolphin tour. You’ll also learn a bit about the history of Hilton Head Island and life on our beautiful island. Enjoy a relaxing Hilton Head dolphin tour with Captain Mark, the most experienced Captain on Hilton Head. This calm-water cruise highlights our coastal wildlife, nature, and history. services.desc: Just when you thought our cruises couldn’t get any better … we went and added fireworks! (You’re welcome!) Join us every Tuesday night (June 13 through Aug 15) as we celebrate Shelter Cove’s Harbourfest in first-class style. Harbourfest is jam-packed with fun activities, from live music, food vendors, face painting, and, of course, a dazzling fireworks display. And the best way to see this awesome light show is on Captain Mark’s cruise!
